The '''''Blackmist''''' was a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|Corellian corvette]] that was owned by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] criminal [[Noako]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The ''Blackmist'' was Noako's best [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]] and it was destroyed after Noako's rival [[Sinasu]] had the vessel crash into Noako's own landing pad. In retaliation, agents of Noako torched Sinasu's docking facility [[Greentop Tower]], on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].
